title: One shape prompt (one JSON object per line of prompts_shape.jsonl). Body only: no motion words.

text.description: the prompt exactly as given to the system; English; describes the body only

subject.description: free text, e.g. goblin, giraffe, robot

attributes.description: e.g. stocky, long legs, big ears, tail

expected_legs.description: 2, 4, 0, 6 ...; null if the prompt does not say

split.description: dev: tune the judge prompt and thresholds; test: touched once per system version
